text: A woman with long, straight black hair, pale skin, and a slender build stands in profile. Her face is oval, lips red, eyes dark. She wears a deep purple V-neck garment. A single dangling earring adorns her left ear. Hair falls past shoulders. She gazes upward, mouth slightly open as if singing or speaking. Background is blurred blue-green mist with faint vertical shapes. No other figures visible.
